Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent game sprite, tier 1 of the newly invented Stormspire — The Tempest Spire.
Only design brief: "A stone spire crowned with an enchanted iron staff that calls forked lightning down upon several enemies at once. Its identity is a storm mage's ward, spreading the fury of the heavens across an advancing warband." Invent this design from this text alone. Use no previous tower or artwork.
Create exactly one simple, dark medieval fantasy tower: a tall tapering monolithic stone spire, crowned by one clearly visible long forged iron mage's staff with a bold two-pronged fork head and a small solid storm-blue inset between the prongs. The spire has three broad matte stone planes, two quiet masonry breaks, a single iron binding collar, and a small low buildup of chunky crumbly stones at its foot. The staff is an enchanted medieval ward, never a modern antenna. Keep the basic structure spare so future upgrades can be added.
Composition: exactly 1024x1024 square, straight front view with a subtle view of the stone top planes, absolutely centered vertical axis x=512. Contact point at (512,900); lowest opaque rubble pixel y=900. Core stone approximately x=402..622, y=530..868. Foundation approximately x=346..678, y=845..900. Staff shaft centered at x=512, from stone top to fork head; entire tier-one silhouette above the foundation starts about y=325. Leave large transparent margins at the sides and above for additive upgrades. Full structure visible. Genuinely transparent background and no backdrop.
Style: simple illustrative 2D inked dark fantasy, few large readable shapes, bold black outlines and dark structural separations, two or three crisp flat shading planes per material. Matte, somber and ancient. Quiet broad surfaces, minimal chips. No smooth gradients, photorealism, glossy 3D, noisy texture or filigree.
Choose EXACTLY from this 16-color family palette, no additional RGB shades: #000000 outline; #131C20 deep shadow; #273239 stone shadow; #414E53 stone side; #5D6A6B stone front; #7B8785 stone worn edge; #252A30 iron shadow; #454F59 iron face; #697985 iron edge; #3A3530 binding shadow; #655847 aged binding face; #88745B binding edge; #466779 storm-blue inset shadow; #8BAEBB storm-blue inset face; #625C7D reserved violet branch shadow; #A09DB9 reserved violet branch face. Do not use violet in tier 1. Transparent pixels are separate from the palette.
This is a STATIC tower asset: no lightning bolts in the air, attack effects, projectiles, enemies, people, sky, clouds, ground tile, fire, flames, banners, shield emblem, moon, text, labels, frame or watermark. Spell identity comes from the forked iron staff and solid compact inset, not floating effects.
